What Is ACE-031?

 ACE-031 is a synthetic myostatin inhibitor peptide derived from the extracellular domain of the activin type IIB receptor. It is primarily used in preclinical research to study skeletal muscle growth, tissue regeneration, and muscle-wasting pathways . ACE-031 binds to myostatin and other TGF-β family ligands , preventing their interaction with receptors, which makes it a valuable tool for researching muscle mass regulation and anabolic signaling .

 This product is strictly for laboratory research and is not intended for human or animal consumption .
